text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During personal dance practice, T.M. Opera O
was speaking to her reflection in the mirror...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“Ah, Opera O in the mirror...
Why must you be so breathtakingly beautiful?”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: A charm capable of threatening even me, the "End-of-Century Overlord"...Truly terrifying!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't lose...!
I'm the one who will dominate the path of supremacy and stand at the summit!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Kh! After competing so many times,
you still haven't dropped to your knees...

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O-saaan!
We're closing the studio soon, okay~?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...!?
Even though the match hasn't even been decided yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Forced to pack up halfway through, T.M. Opera O sank into a state of shock and dejection.
